note: The pro reels to render (scripts/marketing/pro-reel.mjs). photos: gallery numbers in shot order (1-based, from <id>-gallery.jpg; never a photo with printed text, sizes or a brand); without it the gallery in order. fit: photo numbers shown whole over a blurred copy (wide products). focus: per photo number {cx, cy} (0..1) when the product is off-centre. crop: per photo number [x, y, w, h] fractions, to leave out printed text and marks; {"from": n, "box": [...]} makes a new photo number from photo n.
